choices.title: Fiber Cement
choices.description: Fiber Cement siding is highly durable siding option. Allows for color customization as it will require painting to finish. This option will be more expensive than an LP or Vinyl Siding.

selections.title: Exterior Siding Base Color
selections.description: Please Visit the Sherwin Williams website at: https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color to select your primary color. This base color will be for the majority of the exterior.

selections.title: Exterior Siding Secondary Accent Color
selections.description: Please Visit the Sherwin Williams website at: https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color to select a color and input a selection here. This will act as a secondary accent color, (such as for a gable end if different) but is not the trim color. Please see Exterior Trim Color selection to select this color if you will not have a secondary accent color.

selections.title: Exterior Trim Color
selections.description: Please Visit the Sherwin Williams website at: https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color to select a color for your trim. This color will be for the siding trim at corners and around openings. Typically speaking this color will match your soffit and fascia color but is not required to.
